name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-04-03, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 4.27 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
